overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' ability to generate text with citations across three datasets. It uses a comprehensive set of automatic metrics (fluency, correctness, citation quality) and validates them with human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of redundant entries.
